extracted.name: Chicken & mushroom pancake topping
extracted.description: This creamy pancake topping makes a great quick dinner, plus it's low cal and so satisfying
instruction_lines: Melt the butter in a pan, add the mushrooms and cook until softened, about 8 mins. Add the garlic and cook for 1 min more, then stir in the flour, milk, mustard and ketchup. Stir for a few mins until you have a thick sauce, then season well.
Shred the chicken and add to the sauce along with the parsley. Top four warm pancakes (see our easy pancakes recipe) with the chicken & mushroom mix and serve.
